description: FULL BODY. A Malaysian male in his late 30s, athletic build, wearing a professional dark blue Royal Malaysia Police uniform with silver buttons, official badges, and a peak cap. Short black hair, clean-shaven, wearing black leather boots.

FULL BODY. A Malaysian woman in her 50s, Madam Lee, of Chinese descent, wearing a traditional red floral samfoo top and dark loose trousers. She has short permed hair and is wearing simple gold earrings and comfortable slippers.

FULL BODY. An anonymous, featureless human-shaped silhouette draped in a glitching digital texture. The figure is completely dark with glowing cyan binary code patterns coursing through its form, wearing a hooded jacket that hides any facial features.

FULL BODY. A Malaysian man in his 30s wearing a professional white dress shirt, a navy blue tie, and formal black trousers. He has a clean-cut hairstyle and wears a silver wristwatch and black dress shoes.

FULL BODY. A Malaysian woman in her late 20s wearing a corporate grey blazer over a black modest blouse and matching slacks. She has her hair tied back in a neat ponytail and is wearing professional black loafers.
